about: The oracle corpus for background-check wording (reviews B and B2): the page regex that the shared list replaced (BACKGROUND_WORDING in core/src/ask.ts as of v0.1.0, over that version's fold) runs on it in core/test/harness/background-wording-oracle.test.ts, and the list must refuse everything that regex refused, apart from allowlist (Ozzie's one own sentence, as a whole string). Each side builds the same corpus: every prefix + word + suffix, then every prefix + subject + " " + verb (with a space after it, or none for the empty verb) + tail, each of those also in upper case; then for every separator and every word, the word with each space replaced by the separator followed by the separator and "renewal", and the word's first letter, the separator and the rest of the word; then for every sentence and every affix, affix + sentence, sentence + affix and affix + sentence + affix; then rows as written. The sha-256 of one line per text, "1 " or "0 " (refused or not) and the text, each ending in a line feed, is digest: the page (that test), native (background.rs tests) and ozzie.church (hosted-parity.test.ts) must all reach it. Regenerate digest only after a deliberate change to the list. Fictional names only.
